versions.content: To notify the upper layer about the termination of an active TP reception on closing a socket connection within SoAd_MainFuncti on() , SoAd shall call <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]RxIndication() with parameter result set to (1) E_OK if disconnection is caused by SoAd_CloseSoCon() and all received data was correctly delivered to the upper layer, and (2) E_NOT_OK for any other cause.
